title: The cheapest thing on that coat is the logo
description: Logo-free luxury costs more than branded luxury, and not because it is better made. The label is not what you were paying for. The label was holding the price down.

scenes.narration: Nothing here carries a logo. That is the expensive part.
scenes.imagePrompt: A dark cashmere overcoat on a wooden hanger photographed from behind and slightly to one side, the whole back panel and shoulder line clearly visible and evenly lit by a broad soft light, plain unbroken fabric, dim wardrobe behind, no people

scenes.narration: A cashmere coat with a visible label sells for around two thousand dollars.
scenes.imagePrompt: Macro of a folded dark wool coat sleeve and a single horn button on a black surface, one hard light from the side, shallow focus, plain fabric, no labels

scenes.narration: The same cloth, unbranded, from a mill that supplies both, runs closer to six.
scenes.imagePrompt: Macro of raw pale cashmere fibre heaped in a dim textile mill, one shaft of light catching the soft nap, dark machinery receding behind it, no people

scenes.narration: You were never paying for the logo. The logo was subsidising the price.
scenes.imagePrompt: Close detail of hand stitching running along the inside seam of a dark tailored jacket, needle and dark thread, warm low lamp light, hands out of frame, plain cloth

scenes.narration: A logo house ships millions of units a year. The quiet one ships a hundred times fewer.
scenes.imagePrompt: Rows of identical dark coats on a long rail receding into a dim warehouse, low overhead light, deep one-point perspective, plain garments, no people

scenes.narration: There is no volume to spread the cost across, and no advertising to inherit.
scenes.imagePrompt: Interior of an empty quiet boutique at night, plain oak shelving holding a few folded knitwear stacks, warm low lighting, deep shadow in the corners, no signage, no people

scenes.narration: The label pays for itself. Its absence has to be paid for by you.
scenes.imagePrompt: Extreme macro of the plain dark wool cuff of a coat sleeve folded back on itself, neat stitched edge, smooth unbroken fabric, single raking light, deep surrounding shadow

scenes.narration: So the cheapest thing on that coat was always the logo.
scenes.imagePrompt: A dark cashmere overcoat on a wooden hanger seen from directly behind in a dim wardrobe, only the plain back panel and shoulder line visible, one warm shaft of light falling across it, deep shadow, no people
